notes: Fixes the playback wrapper promoting ordinary even-sized 4:2:0 video to 4:4:4 before mpv selects its video track. Uses available container dimensions and explicit track selection, while preserving safe odd-size and preceding-filter handling. Defaults an unset mpv autofit-larger to 100%x100% for both interpolated and original playback: small videos keep their natural window size and oversized videos fit the screen. Existing user and command-line window overrides are respected; processing dimensions and aspect remain unchanged. Adds extracted-package chroma-format, original-playback and window-option regressions. Replaces mandatory CPU error-diffusion conversion with configurable dithering, defaulting to fast ordered dithering. Set JSON dither to error_diffusion to retain the previous quantization method; the noise/quantization pattern can differ. Native engine, shaders, processing resolution, buffering and decoder defaults are unchanged. ARM64 plugins are built and tested in CI, ad-hoc signed and not notarized. External mpv, Python and VapourSynth are required.
